_comment: calibrate_bus_runtimes.py: stop pairs in --section-times use sectionTimes; other hops = (secPerMeter x hop metres + secPerHop) x trip time-of-day factor. Fitted 2026-10-14 to ODsay sectionTime (60 OD, legs with >= 3 stops, first lane only, least squares on relative error). Evidence and fit scripts: docs/plan/bus-runtime-calibration/research/calibration/. Regions without ODsay samples stay unchanged.

sectionTimes._comment: with --section-times (fetch_seoul_section_times.py, Seoul TOPIS stop-pair hourly running time): hop = scale x section seconds for the departure hour. scale 0.98 (issue #413): live positions 2026-10-14 13-15 h Jamsil->Gangnam (28 full runs) were 5.5 % longer than scale 0.935; estimate ODsay 9.4 %, real 5.4 %. 0.935 = position-label average (Seoul 208 routes).

_longHopComment: hops >= 3 km with no section time keep their KTDB running time (expressway sections of M/광역/직행좌석 buses). ODsay 730 legs: express 14.0 -> 11.2 %, legs with a 3 km+ hop 10.1 -> 4.8 %, all 10.6 -> 10.4 %. Without it M4403 동탄 -> 강남 was 68 min vs Naver 45 (KTDB 45.5).
